definition_one_sentence: Customer account with at least one non-cancelled order in the last 12 rolling months.
formula_or_rule: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
example: Customer account with an order 4 months ago and status = 'delivered' is active
notes_conflicts: Sales wants 6 months for seasonal campaigns; Finance requires 12 months and non-cancelled orders for board/annual reporting. Keep 12m as canonical and expose a 6m view/filter for Sales.

definition_one_sentence: Order revenue excluding VAT and after refunds, keeping shipping fees (excluding cancelled orders).
formula_or_rule: ROUND((gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur) / 1.20, 2) (with shipping included and status != 'cancelled')
example: 120.00 EUR gross order with 0.00 EUR refund and 20% VAT -> 100.00 EUR net revenue
notes_conflicts: Sales asked to keep VAT for commercial/commission views while Finance requires excluding VAT for board/accounts. Keep VAT-excluded net revenue as canonical and keep gross/sales views separate.

definition_one_sentence: Customer account that previously ordered at least once but has placed no non-cancelled order in the last 12 rolling months.
formula_or_rule: last_order_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months' AND lifetime_orders > 0
example: Account with last order 15 months ago is churned; a brand-new account with 0 orders is not churned
owner_who_decides: Paul Girard (Head of Finance) & Sara Martin (Head of Sales)
notes_conflicts: Must distinguish never-ordered accounts from previously active accounts; exact inactivity window (e.g. 12m vs churn ML threshold) to confirm.

definition_one_sentence: Account record in ShopFast representing a buyer profile in the customer table (one person may have multiple accounts).
formula_or_rule: One row per customer_id in stg_customers / dim_customers
notes_conflicts: One real person can have multiple accounts (duplicate accounts / emails); document account grain clearly.

definition_one_sentence: A customer purchase transaction placed on the platform with an order lifecycle status and amount.
formula_or_rule: One row per order_id in stg_orders / fct_orders
notes_conflicts: Cancelled orders are excluded from active customer and net revenue calculations.
